text_block_list.text:
Waaaah, so many...!!
You're amazing, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "With this many, I can share them not just with Mom, but with Grass-chan, El-chan, and all our other friends too~!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Besides—oh, I know!
Let's decorate the Trainer's office, too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure every time we look at it, we'll remember
how much fun we had today together. Ehehe♪"
